integrity: Analytic finite-dimensional formulas and asymptotics supported by supplementary numerical checks; historical priority not exhaustively resolved; independent validation absent.
scientific_limitations: The paired law applies to axial spheroids with common intrinsic aspect ratio and IUR affine hyperplanes; it is not a sufficient-statistic assertion for full observed section data. Earlier specialized stereological tables could contain implicit equivalences.
title: Universal power-tilt duality for affine sections of prolate and oblate spheroids
